title: Our Services
intro: Complete automotive care for every mile ahead. From routine maintenance to complex diagnostics, Marshall Automotive LLC keeps Hermitage on the road.

services.title: Engine Diagnostics
services.description: Check engine light on? We pull the codes, test the systems, and explain exactly what your vehicle needs — no guesswork, no upselling.

services.title: Brake Service
services.description: Pads, rotors, calipers, lines, and fluid. We inspect the full braking system and only replace what is genuinely worn.

services.title: Oil Changes
services.description: Conventional, blend, or full synthetic with a quality filter, plus a courtesy inspection of belts, hoses, and fluid levels.

services.title: Tires & Wheels
services.description: Mounting, balancing, rotation, and repairs. We help you pick the right tire for how and where you actually drive.

services.title: Transmission Repair
services.description: Fluid services, diagnostics, and repair for automatic and manual transmissions — shifting problems sorted out properly.

services.title: Suspension & Steering
services.description: Struts, shocks, control arms, tie rods, and alignment-related repairs to bring back a smooth, straight ride.

services.title: A/C & Heating
services.description: Recharge, leak detection, compressor and blower repair — comfortable in a Tennessee summer and a January morning.

services.title: And More
services.description: Batteries, starters, alternators, belts, hoses, water pumps, timing components, and pre-purchase inspections. Just ask.
